question: (1)/(20) { is what percentage of } (10)/(50)?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Target value = 1/20 and Base value = 10/50 = 1/5

Required Percentage = (Target ÷ Base) × 100

Required Percentage = (1/20 ÷ 1/5) × 100

Required Percentage = (1/20 × 5) × 100

Required Percentage = 1/4 × 100 = 25%

**∴ The correct answer is 25%.**
